<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market sell-off:</strong> The Sensex plunged over 800 points and the Nifty closed below 23,450 as Brent crude prices crossed $100 per barrel, exacerbated by escalating Middle East tensions and a sharp decline in IT stocks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPUHR1TU5MTUFvQ3A3RWhxM3hRdE12X3BGaXVmdmVXbDAzUmhoSHJvaEM3MGhrOXdqd0NZazZVVXVCUkY3b2xsY1JsTWxMeDEtdW1XaDRud0tjODQ1Wkk3RG5JVmFQeWlhVmM4eGlFUFZ6Z2xDajZsU25XWjZ1d3Z6SnpEWGRKWUdJWHhFWWdvdjVKQ09OU3Rya3BWVQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity management:</strong> The RBI has initiated currency swaps to drain a record $115 billion (approx. ₹11 trillion) in banking system liquidity to manage the surplus cash environment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPMVZwc0lvZHBuaUZfSzJ0NXhaNmRmdlJQdVFzTHZOWDJ4bjhSTDNnX00tclNGdGlzeWMyRFY5ZlI0b2RFUGx4dFVVcVJzOGlWTkJmdU5fQ3pNbDZuT0taQXJpZ0t1VUNYWWdxTGVmRFo3M012WEY0YllZQjdwMlZoa3p2cmFzVXBkT2JtWUxMRjU4Tk1IZG42T2JJVWJUVzJuLXhYUG5NaXR0QzkyTXhoMzVqSkhSZEZYd1RTUg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory updates:</strong> SEBI Chairman confirmed that the National Stock Exchange (NSE) is nearing approval for its IPO, with reports suggesting a potential issue size of ₹26,500 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPZDl3NmxFVjNaanVBeUxmMnh3bV9rSF9SWHdyWHpocEMwbGw2QjhWazdxa25FRVhMZEQwbHZHUl96aUxVUUZ3c2todW9zSzlQQlg1bUZ3bzJSRDdFWW0wUHVITGJvdUROT3Fva3pvbS1wUXBwUFZvM1hIcXB0T2JybGRfTWh2UGM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I42</a></span></li>
</ul>
